summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) filed a 6-K disclosing an improved exchange ratio in the previously announced voluntary exchange offers by parent Banco Santander, S.A. The ratio rose 5%, to 0.4260 Santander shares per Santander Brasil unit or ADS (from 0.4056) and 0.2130 per common or preferred share (from 0.2028); dividend-adjusted equivalents are 0.4246 and roughly 0.212. Consideration remains Banco Santander shares delivered as BDRs or NYSE ADSs. Santander will seek capital-increase approval at an EGM expected 15 December 2026. Watch tender acceptance, minority overhang and the shareholder-vote and regulatory timeline.
